Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for sending the request id. We've escalated this internally. A few important items up front so expectations are clear:

- Short answer: we can perform a targeted removal or redact identified content from our active serving logs and indices, and provide an attestation.
- Limitations: depending on where the data appears (hot serving cache, write-ahead logs, message bus topics, object storage snapshots, or third-party backups), some older backups may require a separate purge/process and could take longer.
- Evidence: we'll provide a deletion attestation and a summary of systems touched (service logs, index entries, storage objects). For legal purposes we'll also capture the job id(s).

Next steps we need from you:
1) Confirm authority to request deletion (POA/email from your security/compliance lead).
2) Confirm the exact conversation identifier(s) you want removed — I have req-20260209-AH-77 from your file but please confirm thread id and any associated request ids.

I'm looping in Marcus (infra) and Rishi (legal) to outline the technical and compliance steps. We'll aim to provide a timeline within 24 business hours after we have your confirmation and POA.

-neha
Neha Kapoor\Account Lead, Strategic Sales\Redwood Inference

Quick technical summary after initial look:

- Candidate namespaces: request logs in redis-prefix 'serving:requests', long-term indices in our ES cluster 'inference-logs-*', object blobs on s3://redwood-prod-logs, and the Kafka topic 'req-events'.
- Procedure: 1) Pin job to locate blobs/keys referencing req-20260209-AH-77. 2) Remove keys/objects and update ES indices to delete matching documents; perform reindex if needed. 3) Rotate any cache/kv state and invalidate prefixes. 4) For backups/snapshots older than 30 days we need to queue a separate irreversible purge; those are infrequent but may require 7-14 day window due to snapshot retention tooling.
- Estimated time: hot-data redaction + attestation: 24-48 hours once POA and exact ids are confirmed. Full backup purge (if required) could add up to 14 days.

I'll create the removal job and reply with job id(s). We will not touch customer-visible data in accounts without Rishi confirming legal sufficiency of the POA.

Marcus
Staff SRE, Platform

Samantha — POA looks good for the requested scope. A couple of compliance notes:

- We'll capture a signed deletion attestation including scope (systems touched), timestamps, job ids, and the person who approved.
- We will preserve an internal audit trail that notes the removal action occurred, but the attestation will not contain the original PHI (we never include PHI in our attestation). This is standard for regulated customers — if Acme needs more evidence, we can discuss an on-prem audit or an encrypted snapshot review session.
- To be explicit: deletion of the active logs and indices is irreversible once executed. For backups/snapshots we will do a purge process and provide target dates for completion.

Please confirm you'd like us to proceed now; Marcus, please start the discovery job and hold on actual deletion until I confirm.

-rishi
